title: Pilot Identification
story: The onboard computer needs a personalized welcome for each new pilot.
lesson: An f-string inserts variables into text with curly braces: f'Hello, {name}'. The 'f' matters.
objective: Make greet_pilot(name) return exactly 'Welcome aboard, NAME!' with NAME replaced by the input.
hint: Start your return value with f before the quote, then put {name} inside the message.
